QUOTE: "dynamic tests under Valgrind and MemorySanitizer" and "The gate is `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_VALGRIND` (`mbedtls_config.h:2126`). A MemorySanitizer variant also exists"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names the Valgrind/MemSan test facility and its config gate. It never says the facility is off by default, and it never says the facility is explicitly not part of the library API.
